style.styleTitle: Homcom 3Ft Prelit Tabletop Christmas Tree With LED Lights

Covered in white, it also comes with warm white LED lights, so all you have to do is add tree decorations (if you wish). And it s easy to set up too: simply fit the base onto the body - then you bend the branches to the place you want. The cement base weighs it down, wrapped in linen. A full and bushy snowy christmas tree here to make the right impression.<br>&nbsp;- Thick and tough plastic. Tree to be used time and again. Flame retardant for safety;<br>&nbsp;- Beautiful snowy design. style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted: Strike up a snowy atmosphere in your Christmas home with this HOMCOM tabletop Christmas tree. Covered in white, it also comes with warm white LED lights, so all you have to do is add tree decorations if you wish. It’s easy to set up too. Simply fit the base onto the body, then bend the branches into the desired position. The cement base weighs it down and is wrapped in linen. This full and bushy snowy Christmas tree is sure to make the right impression. Thick and tough plastic construction, allowing the tree to be used time and again. Flame-retardant for safety. Beautiful snowy design with realistic branches and warm white LED lights. Fit the base onto the single-piece tree and spread the branches into place. Linen-wrapped cement base for added weight. Mini 3ft size with 133 branches, excellent for tabletops. Colour: Green. Light colour: Warm White. Material: Plastic, Concrete, Metal. Overall dimensions: F47 x 91.44Hcm. Tree height: 3ft. Tip count: 133. LED count: 50. Cord length: 0.3m. Item label: 830-922V00GN. Note: For indoor use only, not for outdoor use. To achieve a full appearance, spread out all individual tips for the best look. It is recommended to spend five minutes shaping the tree.
